text:
Plant Club boxes ship in the **first full week of the month**.

Billing happens earlier: you're charged on the **25th of the previous month**. For example, the box that ships in the first full week of November is billed on October 25th.

A few related timing details:
- If you skip, pause, change your plan, or cancel **before the 25th**, it affects your next box. On or after the 25th, the change applies to the following month's box.
- An already-billed box isn't refunded if you cancel, and it will still be sent.

You can manage all of this under "Account" > "Subscriptions."

The policy doesn't give an exact shipping day within that first full week, or a delivery timeframe for Plant Club boxes. If you need that, I can escalate it for you.
